payload.title: Run the editorial example to 1,000+ cycles and record the learning curve
payload.description: Run the prequential study on the extended corpus with review-everything feedback, same decision model and optimizer settings as the 400-cycle recording, and record per-100-cycle windows: accuracy, precision, recall, F1, Brier, calibration error, mean stated confidence, optimizer events, model calls, wall-clock time, and provider cost. Questions: where does accuracy plateau, how many corrections did it take, and what did the run cost. Acceptance: a recording directory plus an exported fixture (same schema as editorial-run-v1 with a schema bump) and a short results note with the curve.
